name: Randall Lough
summary: Senior full-stack engineer with 8+ years of experience building web and mobile products in TypeScript, React, Go, and Python. Focused on AI-native interfaces and agent tool systems, along with the verification loops, lint gates, and test suites that keep agent-written code reliable in production.

positions.title: Torrey Pines Golf Course
responsibilities: Rebuilding the course's online storefront solo on Shopify Hydrogen using AI-assisted workflows, owning catalog, search, cart, customer accounts, and checkout end to end.
Building an embedded Shopify Admin CMS so staff can edit storefront content in the admin they use.
Holding agent-generated code to human PR quality through repo rules and custom lint gates enforced on commit, push, and CI.
Protecting core purchase flows (product, cart, and checkout) with Storybook component coverage and Playwright end-to-end tests.

positions.title: Appraisal Desk
responsibilities: Designed and built an inspection scheduler so appraisers can book, manage, and update inspections.
Set up the testing foundation across unit, integration, and Playwright end-to-end suites.
Built GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines that made daily production releases routine and low-risk.

experience.overview: Software agents, backed by human operators, handling everyday tasks for members.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Rebuilt the signup flow across web and React Native, spanning account creation, checkout, and activation.
Instrumented the signup funnel to pinpoint drop-off and validate experiments, driving ~32% more signups.
Evolved Duckbill's AI agent chat UI, adding interactive, task-specific widgets directly inside member chat.
Hardened member task flows by clarifying operator escalations and resolving edge cases across VIP tasks.
Rolled out AI-assisted frontend workflows combining context docs, lint rules, and Playwright E2E verification loops so engineers could ship faster with agents without sacrificing quality.
Built an internal engineering handbook (triage, on-call, architecture, practices) wired to AI workflows that automatically kept docs in sync as the codebase changed.

experience.overview: Fintech company with project-based charge cards, AI automations, and conversational tools.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Took Zena's AI agent chat UI from initial prototype to production, establishing the foundation for every conversational workflow in the product.
Re-architected agent tool definitions from static configs into a typed object model, making it straightforward to expand agent capabilities safely.
Designed a flexible entitlements system supporting usage limits and granular permissions rather than simple on/off feature flags.

positions.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Led frontend engineering for a company-wide redesign, partnering with design and product to ship a documented component library and an HTMX pattern for fast, SPA-like navigation.
Implemented OpenSearch-backed search so users could quickly query and filter imported transactions.
Hardened the API layer by adding GraphQL schema validation to CI, standardizing error handling, and leading the team's GraphQL-vs.-REST architecture review.
Stood up Zena's first on-call rotation and facilitated weekly engineering retrospectives, turning triage and delivery feedback into repeatable team playbooks.

experience.overview: Employee benefits platform with self-service tools and AI-assisted underwriting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Led a frontend rewrite in TypeScript and Next.js that cut feature delivery cycles by 40%, guiding the engineering team through adoption.
Built a company-wide Go CLI, backed by automated tests and CI/CD, to handle routine developer workflows like spinning up services and updating dependencies.
Mentored junior engineers in Go and system design.

positions.title: Support Engineer
responsibilities: Shipped self-service admin tools (like merging duplicate accounts and assigning primary accounts) that cut support ticket volume by 12%.
Partnered across teams to trace recurring customer issues to root causes and close workflow gaps.
Expanded automated test coverage around bug-prone workflows to keep regressions out of production.

experience.overview: Cloud-based back-office platform for order, inventory, and warehouse workflows.

positions.title: Marketing Manager and Web Developer
responsibilities: Built and launched the company's custom marketing site from scratch, saving tens of thousands of dollars and improving its mobile experience and conversion funnels.
Ran a multichannel marketing strategy that grew organic search traffic 35% month over month.
Increased demo requests 840% and contract generation 1,500% through coordinated content campaigns.
Produced blog posts, ebooks, case studies, videos, webinars, and paid ads for lead generation.

projects.name: Just Plain Coffee
projects.description: An ecommerce app that sells coffee beans and merch using React and Shopify.
items: Built a headless Shopify storefront with Hydrogen, React Router 7, and TypeScript supporting product discovery, cart, subscriptions, and order management.
Generated end-to-end type-safe Storefront and Customer Account API clients using GraphQL codegen.
Configured a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo with colocated Storybook stories, automated accessibility checks, Git hooks, type-aware linting, and production build validation.

projects.name: Camelot
projects.description: A multi-tenant iOS app that allows parents to track their child's daily activities.
items: Built a native SwiftUI iOS 26 app backed by SwiftData for tracking feeding, sleep, diapers, and daily check-ins, normalizing timestamps in UTC and rendering in the child's local time zone.
Implemented invite-only family sharing via per-child CloudKit zones (CKShare), isolating each caregiver's private check-ins in a separate unshared zone.
Engineered a custom CKSyncEngine layer spanning private and shared databases with last-writer-wins conflict resolution, delete tombstones, and background persistence on a ModelActor.
Built cross-caregiver sleep Live Activities delivered to Lock Screens via a Cloudflare Worker push relay, with Maestro E2E tests and tag-triggered TestFlight releases.

projects.name: Don't Forget
projects.description: A collaborative, multi-tenant iOS app that works offline.
items: Built the app as a full-stack TypeScript monorepo with an Expo/React Native iOS client, a Hono API, a TanStack web app, shared Zod contracts, and Drizzle/Postgres storage.
Used PowerSync and OP-SQLite for offline list and item updates, reactive queries, and background sync. Added tombstones and last-writer-wins conflict handling.

Built household sharing with Clerk authentication, membership-scoped replication, server-side row authorization, and role-based permissions. Members can join through invitations or reusable household codes.
Added React Native Storybook to QA screens and component states in isolation before testing them in the app.

projects.name: Resume Builder
projects.description: A Go resume builder that turns JSON into an ATS-friendly LaTeX resume.
items: Built a Go pipeline that loads version-controlled JSON into typed models, renders a Go template to LaTeX, and compiles the PDF with LuaTeX inside Docker.
Wrote a Goldmark AST renderer that converts Markdown cover letters to LaTeX, including headings, emphasis, code, links, and nested lists.

projects.name: PGX Scan
projects.description: A PGX plugin that maps SQL query results to Go structs.
items: Maintained a Go library that extended PGX with direct scanning from query results into Go structs and custom data types.
Added JSON column support, nested struct scanning, and configurable join-table column notation.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
